content.value: Consider a Hash Table of size m = 11 with hash function h(k) = k mod m. Draw the table that (15) result after inserting in the given order, the values 75, 66, 42, 91, 100, 37, 26 for each of the scenario below:
(i) When collisions are handled by chaining.
(ii) When collisions are handled by linear Probing.
(iii) When Collisions are handled by double hashing using a second hash function $h ^ { \prime } ( k ) = 1 0 - ( k m o d 1 0 ) .$
